text: Capelli Sport operates under the umbrella of GMA Accessories, Inc., a New York fashion and apparel company led by owner and CEO George Altirs, who founded GMA Accessories and launched Capelli Sport in 2011; the company is described as still privately held.
short: Capelli Sport is part of GMA Accessories, the private New York apparel company founded and owned by George Altirs.

source.name: Capelli Sport+: '+Consulting' (capellisportplus.com)
source.quote: Capelli Sport is unique in that we are an international business consortium under the umbrella of GMA Accessories, Inc., which has over 30 years of expertise in global supply chain management and manufacturing led by owner and CEO, George Altirs.

additionalSources.name: Sportico: 'An Apparel Brand's Rise From a Single Youth Club to the World Cup'
additionalSources.quote: He declined to share any financial information about the company, which is still privately held
